aiMetadata.description: Looks up a phone number via the PhoneValidator API to determine whether it is valid and real. Choose the search type: "basic" returns line type, carrier, location, and a fake-number check, while "fake" runs only the fake/disposable-number check. Use it to verify or enrich a phone number before contacting it; the number can be passed in various formats (e.g. 7029270000 or 1-702-927-0000). This is a read-only lookup, safe to repeat.
